alerts.title: This is Peak Ranked Rivals.
alerts.summary: This was my Celestial game and somehow 3 of my teammates banned Peni and at that point I just conceded we were going to lose so I stopped paying attention to the rest of the ban phase. I look back at my monitor and see 2 more teammate bans. I carried us to victory despite our Thor getting upset and deciding to use Adam(notorious throw selection) but this is my issue with this game in comp. I haven’t played much of comp the last 2 weeks and for the first time since season 0 Ive been playing quick match a ton this season. In quick match I can use my most played hero, Adam, without my team getting upset at me for using him. Ive also been playing Overwatch(my first hero shooter) and returning to it has been so refreshing in many ways. I see no point in grinding comp anymore. The game before this I had a Spiderman go 2-7 1st round and my invisible woman left start of round 2 and we lose. The community ruins this game competitive mode and Im not sure why the devs cant save people from themselves like not being able to ban teammates, enforcing only 2 DPS picks like how Overwatch does it with Tanks, etc. People are so quick to give up after the first round because of the surrender option. In Overwatch there is no quitting. You have to stay and figure it out otherwise you get penalized for leaving. So people are incentivized to figure out a solution on how to turn things around.
